---
name: hook-wiring-is-disposable
description: Applies when chaining a custom check into `.git/hooks/pre-commit` alongside the pre-commit framework.
type: trap
---

**Rule:** Keep the GATE (the script) tracked in the repo, and treat the hook wiring as disposable.
Document how to re-wire it.

**Why:** `.git/hooks/pre-commit` is generated by the pre-commit framework, and `pre-commit install`
drops any chained call you added. If `.pre-commit-config.yaml` is itself generated (e.g. by a devshell)
or gitignored, it is regenerated too, and in a linked worktree the generated config may be absent
entirely. When the hook silently stops firing, nothing announces it; the tracked script plus a note on
how to wire it is what lets you notice and repair.

**How to apply:**

- After any `pre-commit install` or devshell entry, check the hook still calls your gate:
  `grep -c '<gate-script>' .git/hooks/pre-commit`.
- Re-wire by prepending the call to `.git/hooks/pre-commit`.
- Give the gate a manual entry point and a documented release (e.g. an env var with a required reason).

Related: \[[self-modifying-script-byte-offset]\] \[[formatter-check-is-not-a-format-run]\]
